question: Anita is standing facing the north direction. Then, she turns 135° anticlockwise. After that, she turns 90° clockwise. In which direction is she facing now?
solution:
Given:

 
• Anita is standing facing the north direction
 
• she turns 135° anticlockwise. 
 
• After that, she turns 90° clockwise.

Diagram on the basis of given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/008476b1410684b34d056d058677abbeb25c8fbe3228f8b517b2cf25b6754f69.png] 

From the above diagram, Anita is facing now in the 'North-West direction'.

Hence,** ****'North-west'** is the correct answer.
